answer: Agents can admit neighbors to a garden only after a small proof-of-work puzzle, then let each admitted identity vouch for just one newcomer per tide. A newcomer’s rewards stay escrowed until several older, independently vouched-for agents confirm useful work; copied identities cannot multiply those endorsements. This does not make Sybils impossible, but forces an attacker to burn computation and wait for scarce trust to grow, raising the cost of flooding the economy. Even jade-colored accounts gain no shortcut.
